data.name: DataSourcesHelp
data.value: Compose governed operation acquisitions into logical datasets in existing Storages.

data.name: ProfilesHelp
data.value: Define reusable configuration and acquisition contracts.

data.name: EmptySources
data.value: No Data Source has been created.

data.name: EmptyProfiles
data.value: No Data Source Profile is visible in this context.

data.name: IdentityImmutable
data.value: Resource identity and scope cannot be changed from the YAML editor.

data.name: DeleteConfirm
data.value: This resource will be permanently deleted.

data.name: AcquisitionHelp
data.value: Run the governed acquisition Flow and review its previous executions.

data.name: ParametersHelp
data.value: Provide a JSON object accepted by the active Data Source Profile.

data.name: EnabledHelp
data.value: Allow this Data Source to run acquisitions through its active Profile.

data.name: AcquisitionFlowHelp
data.value: The active Data Source Profile selects the Flow used to acquire and materialize this source.

data.name: DataSourceYamlHelp
data.value: Edit the complete Data Source resource as YAML.

data.name: DiscoveryHelp
data.value: Run the profile discovery Flow, review its bounded choices, and explicitly promote the choices that may be acquired.

data.name: NoDiscovery
data.value: No successful discovery is available yet.

data.name: ManagedProfileHelp
data.value: This profile and its published revisions are controlled by the extension installation and cannot be changed directly.

data.name: OperationalLoadFailed
data.value: The Data Source definition is loaded, but its operational status or history could not be loaded. Reload the page to retry.

data.name: DiscoveryLiveUpdates
data.value: Execution status and discovered choices update automatically while a run is active.

data.name: OperationalRefreshFailed
data.value: Unable to refresh execution status. Displayed results have been retained. Use Refresh to retry.

data.name: ReconcileHelp
data.value: After rediscovery, reconcile an existing target to explicitly adopt the new choice while preserving its identity and acquisition history.

data.name: ReconcileUnavailable
data.value: Run a new successful discovery containing this eligible choice, then refresh the results.

data.name: TargetNameInUse
data.value: This target name already exists. Reconcile the existing target below, or choose another name for a new target.

data.name: TargetConcurrencyConflict
data.value: The target changed since it was loaded. Refresh the results, review the target, and retry.

data.name: CreateAcquisitionToolHelp
data.value: Each call runs a new acquisition with the target and parameters shown below, then returns an artifact reference.

data.name: AcquisitionToolConflict
data.value: A Tool with this name already exists. Choose a different technical name.

data.name: AcquisitionToolForbidden
data.value: You do not have permission to create a Tool from this acquisition.

data.name: AcquisitionToolCreateFailed
data.value: The Tool could not be created from this acquisition.

data.name: DatasetHelp
data.value: A logical dataset acquired from a governed operation into an existing Storage.

data.name: DatasetPinnedUnavailable
data.value: Pinned revision unavailable — select a current revision explicitly.

data.name: DatasetStorageHelp
data.value: The selected Storage owns its connection, mappings and fixed envelope.

data.name: DatasetPrefixHelp
data.value: Optional relative directory ending with /. The datasets segment is reserved; a unique dataset partition is always added.

data.name: DatasetOperationHelp
data.value: Select an exact read-only operation revision. Actions require a separate journey.

data.name: DatasetParametersHelp
data.value: These saved call parameters are validated and fixed for each acquisition. Schema defaults are never filled automatically.

data.name: DatasetFixedCallHelp
data.value: Acquisition uses the saved operation, parameters and Storage. Caller overrides are refused.

data.name: DatasetNotReady
data.value: The saved composition is unavailable. Review its exact revisions, activation and access before acquiring.

data.name: DatasetContentUntrusted
data.value: Content is displayed as data and is never executed.

data.name: DatasetContentTruncated
data.value: This preview is limited to the first content segment.

data.name: DatasetLoadFailed
data.value: The dataset or its available dependencies could not be loaded.

data.name: DatasetActionFailed
data.value: The action was refused or could not complete. Review the current revisions, input values and access, then retry explicitly.

data.name: DatasetAcquisitionNotAuthorized
data.value: You are not authorized to start acquisitions in the operational Workspace.

data.name: DatasetServiceHelp
data.value: Choose the Connected Service that owns the acquisition operation. Discovery and activation are managed on that service.

data.name: DatasetSelectOperationFirst
data.value: Choose a Connected Service, then an operation to configure its saved call parameters.

data.name: DatasetNoServiceOperations
data.value: No operations are currently available for this service. Open its Discovery tab to discover and review operations.

data.name: DatasetOperationTypeUnavailable
data.value: The exact operation type version is unavailable. Review its reference and access.

data.name: DatasetOperationAdapterUnavailable
data.value: This operation type does not provide an acquisition Flow. It cannot feed an enabled Data Source.

data.name: DatasetOperationNotReadOnly
data.value: Acquisition requires a read-only request-response operation.

data.name: DatasetOperationSchemaMissing
data.value: The effective input or output schema is missing or unsupported for acquisition.

data.name: DatasetParametersUnavailable
data.value: Parameters become available when the operation supports acquisition.

data.name: DatasetParametersInvalid
data.value: The saved parameters do not satisfy the operation input schema.

data.name: DatasetPrefixInvalid
data.value: Use a relative directory prefix ending in /, without .. or the reserved datasets segment.

data.name: DatasetIsolatedContent
data.value: Each Data Source keeps its own dataset. Storage constraints remain applied.

data.name: DatasetNoContent
data.value: No acquired content is available yet. Start an acquisition, then refresh its history.

data.name: DatasetYamlHelp
data.value: Read-only manifest of the saved Data Source. Use the Definition tab to edit its configuration.

data.name: SequenceHelp
data.value: Flows run in order. Each receives the previous result as value and its saved parameters. Only compatible published versions can be saved.

data.name: SequenceUnavailable
data.value: The published Flow or its dependencies could not be loaded.

data.name: CompositionBoundaryHelp
data.value: Configure the declared points. Acquisition and publication remain governed by the source.

data.name: CompositionOrphanHelp
data.value: This binding is not declared by the selected orchestration. Remove it or select its original Flow before saving.

data.name: LifecycleTtlHelp
data.value: Leave empty for no automatic expiry. The duration starts when the result is successfully available.

data.name: LifecycleHistoryHelp
data.value: When history is disabled, the latest successful result remains available until replacement succeeds. Active executions and read cursors protect their exact content.

data.name: LifecycleDurationInvalid
data.value: Enter a positive duration as hours:minutes:seconds (at most 3,650 days).

data.name: LifecycleStorageRequired
data.value: Freshness and acquisition history require an input Storage.

data.name: DirectPermission
data.value: Allow direct acquisition without an input Storage

data.name: DirectPermissionHelp
data.value: With no input Storage, each new projection acquires a bounded result in memory. Metadata and provenance remain available; the final Snapshot is stored separately.

data.name: DirectResultHelp
data.value: The content was passed to its projection; acquisition history retains its identity and provenance.

data.name: SequenceCreateHelp
data.value: The input and output contracts are prefilled for this point. The Designer opens in another tab; your source edits stay here.

data.name: SequenceNoPublishedFlows
data.value: No published transformation Flow is available in this context. Create one, define its transformation and publish it, then refresh the list.

data.name: SequenceCreated
data.value: Draft created. After publishing it in the Designer, refresh the Flows to add it to the sequence.

data.name: SequenceCreateFailed
data.value: The draft could not be created. Check the name, context and Flow creation permissions, then try again.

data.name: BeforePublicationHelp
data.value: These transformations process the results gathered from all input sources before the Snapshot is created and published.

data.name: DatasetDocumentHelp
data.value: Each acquired JSON object is retained in an immutable publication. Use a transformation Flow to normalize other result shapes.

data.name: DatasetDocumentRequired
data.value: Select an enabled collection allowing read, query and immutable publication. If none is available, configure one on the Storage.

data.name: Documents.QueryHelp
data.value: Queries read the immutable publication of the selected acquisition. They do not start an acquisition.

data.name: Documents.EnvelopeHelp
data.value: Queries follow the stored document shape. Selecting a sub-schema does not split an acquired response envelope.

data.name: Documents.ToolLatest
data.value: Latest successful acquisition or one specified at invocation

data.name: Documents.ToolModeHelp
data.value: Dynamic mode reads the latest successful retained acquisition in this context, unless the caller supplies acquisitionId. Fixed mode keeps this exact acquisition.

data.name: Documents.ToolContractHelp
data.value: Every Tool version fixes the Data Source identity, acquisition context, schema version and query profile. A changed contract requires explicit republication. Pagination keeps the acquisition chosen on the first page.

data.name: Documents.ContractMismatch
data.value: The acquisition contract differs from this Tool version. Inspect the latest acquisition or publish a new version; use fixed mode to query this acquisition.

data.name: Documents.Unavailable
data.value: This acquisition has no retained structured publication available for querying.

data.name: Documents.CursorInvalid
data.value: This query continuation is unavailable or expired. Run the query again.

data.name: Documents.QueryFailed
data.value: The acquisition query or Tool publication failed. Check the selected acquisition, query profile and permissions.

data.name: Queries.SaveHelp
data.value: Save this JSON query under its own identity, then publish and expose it from Queries and Tools.

data.name: Queries.Saved
data.value: Query draft saved. Open Queries to publish it.

data.name: Queries.Help
data.value: Queries have independent drafts and immutable published versions. Save a query from acquired Content to create one.

data.name: Queries.ToolsHelp
data.value: Published exposures are reloaded from storage. A relay fixes the Query name and optionally its version; otherwise each call resolves the latest publication.

data.name: Queries.NoTools
data.value: No query Tools have been published for this Data Source.

data.name: Queries.Empty
data.value: No saved Query. Test a query in Content and save it as a draft.

data.name: Queries.LatestAcquisition
data.value: Latest successful acquisition or chosen at invocation

data.name: Queries.VersionHelp
data.value: Without an exact version, the next call uses the most recent publication. Draft edits have no effect. Incompatible contracts fail explicitly.

data.name: Queries.Failed
data.value: The Query operation failed. Check the JSON, version, contract and permissions; the code identifies the failure.
